description: Variation of condition 2 of approval 26/01492/HOU 26/01492/HOU to allow reduction in depth of ground floor rear extension, first floor rear extension flank wall to sit directly over ground floor flank wall, ground floor roof lights reduced to 2x,  Juliette balcony replaced with rear window and one pair of rear ground floor glazed doors replaced with window.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years from 5th of June 2026 (the date of the original decision notice for application reference 26/01492/HOU). Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

For the purposes of this decision, condition 2 of planning permission 26/01492/HOU shall be replaced with the following condition:The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:SuDS Pro FormaSustainable Drainage Management Plan Planning, Design & Access Statement Location Plan001 Revision R3 002 Revision R3 003 Revision R3004 Revision R3  Block plan of the site   Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.

Unless otherwise specified in the application the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted along with work of making good shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building.  Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.
